hints: There are four operations. Find the ÷ and the × first.
Work out 12 ÷ 4 and 3 × 2. Write the problem again with those answers.
Now only − and + are left. Work from left to right: subtract first, then add.

solution.methodName: PEMDAS: brackets, powers, × ÷ left to right, + − left to right

steps.action: Work from left to right. Subtract first: 20 − 3 = 17.
steps.why: + and − are equal partners, so the one on the left goes first.

trapNotes.10: This works straight from left to right: 20 − 12 = 8, 8 ÷ 4 = 2, 2 + 3 = 5, 5 × 2 = 10. Do ÷ and × before − and +.
trapNotes.11: This adds before subtracting: 20 − (3 + 6) = 11. With only + and − left, go from left to right, so 20 − 3 comes first.
trapNotes.29: This is 20 + 3 + 6. The 3 (from 12 ÷ 4) has a minus sign in front of it, so subtract it.
